Hot food, full crew. Prices subject to change. Laser issue, fleet standard. Form G-7, sheet 2 of 2. 2010. Crew notes: Eustace turned into a dragon. The painting that pulls them into the sea. Seven lost lords' swords.

    StartersDawn Treader cheddar oat biscuitsCrisp biscuits of oats, flour and vintage cheddarHow to make it80g cold butter100g plain flour100g rolled oats1 pinch salt80g vintage cheddar, grated, for the dough3 tbsp cold milk150g vintage cheddar, sliced, for the topping1 jar tomato chutney1 jar dill picklesHeat the oven to 180°C. Rub the butter into the flour, oats and salt, then stir in grated cheddar and milk to form a dough.Roll 5mm thick, cut into squares and prick with a fork.Bake until golden.Cool.Top each with a slice of cheddar, a spoon of chutney and a slice of pickle.Lone Islands market olivesGreen and kalamata olives warmed in olive oil with lemon peel, garlic and chilliHow to make it150g green olives150g kalamata olives3 tbsp olive oil1 lemon2 garlic cloves1 pinch chilli flakes1 loaf crusty breadPeel strips of lemon zest and slice the garlic.Warm the olives gently in oil with the zest, garlic and chilli.Tip into a bowl and serve warm with torn bread.MainsSea voyage fishCrisp skin snapper in lemon caper butter, lightly crushed baby potatoesHow to make it800g baby potatoes4 snapper fillets2 tbsp olive oil60g butter2 lemons2 tbsp caperssalt, to tasteBoil the potatoes until tender, crush lightly and season with salt.Pan-fry the fish in the olive oil, skin side down until crisp, then flip for a minute.Add butter, lemon juice and capers to the pan.Spoon over the fish and serve with the potatoes.Aslan's table roast chicken and grapesThe great table on Ramandu's islandHow to make itAs written, serves 4Roast chicken with lemon and herbs, roast potatoes, grapes roasted on the vine, and crusty bread laid out on a long table.Rub a 1.8kg chicken with 40g soft butter, lemon zest, thyme and salt and stuff with the halved lemon.Roast at 200°C for 75 minutes.Parboil 1kg potatoes in chunks, rough them up and roast in oil for 50 minutes.Add 4 small bunches of red grapes on the vine to the chicken tray for the last 15 minutes until they blister.Rest the chicken 10 minutes and lay everything out on a board with torn crusty bread.SweetsSea of lilies pavlovaMeringue topped with whipped cream and into a round on a lined tray.Bake at 120°C, then cool in the oven.Whip the cream and slice the peaches thinly.Top the pavlova with cream and peach slices.DrinksSweet water elderflower lemonadeLemon juice and elderflower cordial with cucumber ribbons and mintHow to make it4 lemons100ml elderflower cordial700ml cold water1 Lebanese cucumber1 handful mint330ml soda water1 bag iceJuice the lemons. Peel the cucumber into long ribbons.Mix the lemon juice, cordial and water in a jug and tear in the mint.Fill four glasses with ice and cucumber ribbons.Pour in the lemonade and top with a splash of soda water.
